summary: Phase B (Iter7-B) — External Company Search via Annuaire/Recherche d'Entreprises (gouv.fr). Backend: 17/17 tests PASSED (search by q/cp/dep/region/naf, 400 if no criteria, cache TTL 7d hit on 2nd identical call, /companies/siret/{siret} with 404 on invalid, admin /external-cache list/refresh/delete, role gating 403 for non-admin, request logs persisted, profile-v2 accepts new fields siren/postal_code/naf_code/siret_verified/siret_verified_at). Frontend /companies (anonymous): ALL 6 testids present (cs-q, cs-cp, cs-dep, cs-region, cs-naf, cs-submit), search 'decathlon' returned '150 entreprises trouvées' with 12 cards each showing name/region/address/NAF/SIRET, 'Cache' badge appears on 2nd identical call. Header nav-companies link exists in code for logged users (data-testid='nav-companies', route '/companies'). CRITICAL bug found on /register entreprise: SiretLookup component renders an inner <form> nested inside RegisterPage's outer <form>, producing React hydration error AND making the inner search button bubble its click to the parent form — search results never display (Found 0 pick options after waiting). Profile company edit modal uses SiretLookup inside a Dialog (NOT wrapped in form) so should work, but blocked from full UI verification by login flow.

minor.issue: Response does NOT include a cache_hit flag (unlike /companies/search). Detail caching is verified by internal logs only — clients cannot observe cache state. Consider adding cache_hit in the returned dict for parity with search.
Returns 401 (no auth) — fine; documented review_request expected '403 sinon'. Tolerant test passes on (401, 403).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: SiretLookup wraps its input+button in <form onSubmit={search}>. RegisterPage already wraps the whole content in <form onSubmit={submit}>. Nested <form> is invalid HTML (visible hydration error: '<form> cannot contain a nested form'). Clicking the inner siret-lookup-search button (type=submit) submits BOTH forms simultaneously, so the outer register form attempts submission with empty fields; the inner search XHR is fired but the React state update is lost or the page state shifts so results don't render — Playwright observed 0 siret-pick-* nodes after 6s wait.

action_items: HIGH: Fix nested-form bug in /app/frontend/src/components/SiretLookup.jsx. Two simple options: (a) Replace the inner <form onSubmit={search}> with <div> and trigger search via the button's onClick={search}; OR (b) Stop event propagation in search() — but option (a) also fixes the HTML validity hydration error. Recommended: change line 35 to <div className="flex gap-2"> and line 43 button to type="button" onClick={search}. This will also keep the inner Enter-key submission via onKeyDown on the Input if desired.
OPTIONAL: Add cache_hit (and cached_at) to GET /api/companies/siret/{siret} response for parity with /companies/search.

OPTIONAL: ProfilePage edit-modal flow with SiretLookup not fully UI-tested due to login flow time; recommend a quick self-test by main agent after SiretLookup fix to confirm pick prefills edit-company-name / edit-siret / edit-sector / city.

rca of the issue:
RCA — SiretLookup nested form bug:
• Root cause: /app/frontend/src/components/SiretLookup.jsx line 35 renders <form onSubmit={search}> with a child <Button type="submit">. Whenever this component is mounted INSIDE another <form> (RegisterPage line ~80), the DOM contains nested forms which is invalid HTML and causes React to emit a hydration error visible in the browser console: 'In HTML, <form> cannot be a descendant of <form>'.
• Behavioral impact: When the user clicks the inner submit button (type=submit), the browser fires submit on the closest form (SiretLookup's), then bubbles. While preventDefault inside search() stops the inner submit's default, the React reconciliation of the now-invalid DOM tree can cause the parent RegisterPage form to also receive the submit event in some browsers, OR React tears down the inner state — net effect observed in Playwright: the API call appears not to render results (0 siret-pick-* nodes after 6s wait).
• Reproduction: open https://joblink-stages.preview.emergentagent.com/register → click 'Entreprise' card → fill the SIRET lookup input with 'decathlon' → click the blue magnifier button → console emits hydration error → no result cards appear.
• Mitigation: change SiretLookup.jsx to use a <div> + button type="button" onClick={search}; optionally add onKeyDown Enter handler on the Input. This is a 3-line change and is the single recommended fix. After fix, the profile edit modal flow (which already places SiretLookup inside a Dialog, NOT a form, so it should already work) will continue to work; the register page flow will start working.
